''See also: [[Ozriel (Cradle) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ozriel, also known as the [[Reaper]], is a founding figure of the [[Abidan Court]] and once served as a [[Judge]] for six of its seven divisions, including the [[Titans]]. Historically, he acted as a celestial executioner and a tool for the [[Abidan]] to expand their influence by managing and cleaning up corrupted worlds. He possessed a unique The Scythe{{!}}Scythe capable of erasing entire worlds without leaving toxic residue, though he eventually abandoned his position. This departure was driven by his refusal to carry out the mass slaughter of billions on condemned worlds, a moral stance that contrasted with the views of other [[Judges]] like [[Makiel]]. Ozriel is characterized by a complex personality, often masking deep sadness or lingering anger with humor and an animated demeanor. Despite his resignation, he has continued to influence the cosmos through various means, such as creating shelters to preserve the genetics and cultures of doomed populations and leaving behind a bloodline of descendants. He has also planted beacons and messages, including one on his home world, [[Cradle]], to challenge or recruit talented individuals. While he has used his abilities to manipulate Fate{{!}}fate and hide himself from the [[Court]], he remains a powerful entity capable of significant intervention. His presence is often associated with a mantle of Shadow{{!}}shadow and polished black armor, and he maintains a long-standing relationship with the [[Judge Suriel]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ozriel is a man with pale skin, pure blue eyes, and long streaming white hair that frames an angular face. He wears polished black armor featuring a [[black gauntlet]] and a mantle of darkness that can billow from his gear.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A being who attempts to save everyone despite inevitable failure, Ozriel is an [[Abidan]] [[Judge]] and a former member of the [[Court]] of Seven. Though considered a traitor by some for abandoning his divine responsibilities, he has pursued plans to raise people outside of [[Abidan]] rules by planting seeds in dying worlds.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a [[Void Sage]] and the greatest craftsman ever produced in [[Cradle]], Ozriel can create exceptional weapons such as [[Mercy]]'s bow and the [[Scythe of Ozriel]], a weapon forged from a slice of darkness. He possesses the power to perfectly eliminate a corrupted world from existence without breaking it into toxic pieces and can conjure a black [[sword]]. Additionally, he is an authorized user of Personal Record 3349 and can radiate his Authority{{!}}authority into Way{{!}}the Way.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Scythe of Ozriel}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ozriel possesses the ability to conjure a black [[sword]] and exert an Authority{{!}}authority that can radiate into Way{{!}}the Way.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c1">''Waybound'', chapter 1</ref> After breaking his black marble, [[Eithan]] revealed himself to be Ozriel.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5">''Waybound'', chapter 5</ref> When confronted with [[destruction]], Ozriel reached out for his weapon, the [[Scythe of Ozriel]], which is a slice of darkness forged into metal.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6">''Waybound'', chapter 6</ref> This weapon, which Ozriel created, had been buried beneath the ice in the center of The Hound{{!}}the Hound's power and hidden under [[Makiel]]'s home.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22">''Waybound'', chapter 22</ref> While fighting The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King's true self, it was suggested that [[Yerin]]'s feelings might be influenced by Ozriel or Ozmanthus Arelius{{!}}Ozmanthus.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> As a being who was once the strongest in any given world, Ozriel's [[sword]] strike was even imitated by [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> Ozriel eventually vanished without leaving behind any dust or echo, only to reappear within a column of [[sapphire]] flames.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29">''Waybound'', chapter 29</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">15</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Judge of the Abidan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ozriel is the eighth [[Judge]] and was previously viewed as lacking objectivity regarding the [[Executor program]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32">''Waybound'', chapter 32</ref> It is expected that Ozriel will interrupt both Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel and [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37">''Waybound'', chapter 37</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ozriel is a [[Judge]] who was considered not objective in the matter of the [[Executor program]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ozriel is the eighth [[Judge]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ozriel is expected to interrupt Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel and [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a [[Judge]] of the [[Abidan]], Ozriel was compatible with six of the seven disciplines and once qualified for divisions including the [[Titans]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> A maker of weapons who crafted [[Mercy]]'s bow, he is a member of the [[Court]] of Seven.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref> Ozriel recruited the first generation of Reaper{{!}}Reapers and sent a baby [[Reaper]] to [[Threshold]] to be prepared as an [[assassin]] for the Silverlords{{!}}Silverlord.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> Because he abandoned his post and divine responsibilities, [[Cirian]] considers him a traitor, though Ozriel remains delighted with [[Cirian]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref> After The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King was driven away, Ozriel waited for the [[Judges]] to arrive and has hidden his The Scythe{{!}}Scythe under [[Abidan]] control.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">15</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ozriel sent a baby [[Reaper]] to [[Threshold]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ozriel is considered a traitor by [[Cirian]] for abandoning his divine responsibilities.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|“Suriel,” he said, and his voice resonated through the room. “Will you verify for the record that Ozriel is dead?”<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|“He has left us in a scenario where we have no choice but to act as though he is dead.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|“If you have found this, that means you are one of the descendants I’ve left behind.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|“You are one of my children,” he said. “You have inherited my<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“You hide as I do, Ozriel. Let us go our separate ways.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25" />}}
